blurb: Guests follow a 2.5-mile trail highlighting rock formations, waterfalls, and lake views, including a cave and a skybridge overlook. Admission includes access to the Ancient Ozarks Natural History Museum, one digital photo, and one drink at the Bat Bar. Electric carts are available on a first-come, first-served basis for up to four people.
